title: Demo app: delete a single note, in the API and on the page
notes: Acceptance. API: DELETE /api/notes/{note_id} returns 204 and removes only that note, 404 with a detail message for an unknown id; ids stay unique after a delete (a new note never reuses the id of a note that still exists); DELETE /api/notes (clear all) still empties the store and restarts the ids. Page (src/notes_app/static/index.html): each note shows a delete control that is NOT a <button> element (use <span role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Delete note">) because the browser tests use a single <button>; keep the selectors #t #f #n #v and the brand colour #0b5fff. Tests first: unit tests in tests/notes/ and a Playwright test in e2e/test_notes_app.py that adds two notes, deletes one and sees the other remain. The 11 existing browser tests and e2e/test_notes_live.py must keep passing. Do not touch .gitlab-ci.yml.
